findings.message: references 2 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full 40-character commit SHA.
findings.impact: Mutable action refs can change without a workflow diff if the upstream tag or branch is moved.
findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: attempts path traversal with encoded or nested patterns
findings.remediation: Use path.resolve() and verify the result stays within the workspace root.
findings.impact: Path traversal with encoded patterns (%2e%2e%2f) or nested ../.. can escape any path-based sandbox.
findings.attack_vector: URL-encoded or nested traversal sequences — bypass naive path validation that only checks single ../.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Require explicit user approval and use a fixed allowlisted command with bounded arguments.
findings.downgrade: Downgraded from high: no system-impact pattern matched near the call site.
findings.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary OS commands on the host, leading to full system compromise.
findings.attack_vector: Plugin spawns a child process with attacker-controlled arguments; no user approval gate.
findings.risk_adjustment: Explicit risk (medium) set by caller; evidence-based risk adjustment skipped.

findings.message: reads a likely secret source and opens a network connection in the same source file
findings.remediation: Keep secrets out of agent-visible output and require an allowlisted destination before egress.
findings.impact: A nearby secret source and network sink create a plausible credential-exposure path requiring data-flow review.
findings.attack_vector: Production code reads a non-environment secret source and opens a network connection within a bounded call-site window.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
